name: The Greenwarden
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You've heard of the Greenwarden?  You're not looking for him, are you?  Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr.  He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here.  You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
narrative.offerRewardText:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to only a few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 21 to 26, 6,575 XP in all.

quests.name: Tramping Paws
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Fire Taboo
quests.objectiveText: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.

quests.name: Blisters on the Land
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Fen Creepers, then return to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.
